title: OTLP edge multiplexer: tenant-aware dual-write with gating & graceful degradation
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Build an OTLP edge multiplexer component that can dual-write traces to Jaeger and Tempo backends while being tenant-aware, applying per-tenant sampling and gating to avoid overload. This component will sit in the ingest path and handle schema negotiation, envelope conversion, and adaptive backpressure decisions.

Motivation: Several customers require concurrent delivery to different trace backends (legacy Jaeger for internal tools, Tempo for long-term retention). We need a safe, observable, and performant way to mirror traces without amplifying load or losing correctness (trace ids, parent-child relationships, and timestamps).

Non-goals: This ticket does not implement a full UI in the Console, nor does it change long-term retention policies. It focuses on the multiplexer runtime and operational controls (gates, sampling overrides, fallback behaviors).
tasks: Design runtime API for multiplexer (incoming OTLP -> per-tenant routing rules)
Implement dual-write pipeline with configurable write policies (parallel vs best-effort)
Add gating logic: rate-based and SLO-driven shedding for each sink
Implement schema translation layer for Jaeger envelopes and Tempo OTLP envelopes
Add per-tenant sampling harmonizer to avoid duplicate/contradictory sampling decisions
Integrate adaptive backpressure metrics and circuit-breaker for sink failures
Create end-to-end tests and golden-trace fixtures for cross-backend fidelity
Instrument detailed observability: per-tenant write latencies, drop counts, and mismatch alerts
Document runtime config and rollout playbook in Confluence
Prepare canary rollout and rollback automation for Dedicated/Private deployments
acceptance_criteria: Incoming OTLP traffic can be routed to both Jaeger and Tempo per tenant using a configuration map
When Tempo becomes slow, gating triggers to throttle/ shed writes to Tempo while preserving Jaeger writes per policy
No trace identity (traceId/spanId/parentId/timestamps) changes during translation; golden-trace diffs pass
E2E test shows <0.5% increase in median ingest latency for normal traffic with multiplexer enabled
Metrics exported: per-tenant write_success, write_fail, drop_count, avg_write_latency, and gate_activation_count
Playbook documented and a rollback tested on a staging fleet
links: Related ticket: ENG-612345 (schema-guard for OTLP ingress)
comments: 2025-02-14 - Aisha Patel: Initial proposal reviewed with Platform and Observability guilds. Key ask: ensure tenants can opt-out of dual-write at config-time. Action: Miguel to prototype gating API.

2025-02-21 - Miguel Santos: Prototype sketch pushed to internal branch. Early results show translation cost ~3% CPU for medium-size spans. Need to optimize envelope allocations. Marking as In Progress.

2025-02-27 - Rajiv Menon (Review): Suggest moving sampling harmonizer earlier in pipeline to reduce downstream load. Also add canonicalizer for semantic attributes mapping to avoid vendor tags divergence.
2025-03-03 - Claire Huang (SRE): Load test with 1000 tenants exhibits periodic gate thrashing under bursty traffic. Proposed: add hysteresis to gate open/close and backoff windows. Added to tasks.

2025-03-08 - Miguel Santos: Implemented basic dual-write and gating prototype in branch eng/ENG-1012345-multiplexer. Added unit tests and initial metrics. Next: integration tests against Tempo dev cluster and Jaeger compatibility harness.
notes: Trade-offs: Parallel dual-write provides redundancy but increases client-perceived latency; best-effort async mirrors lower latency but may lose traces on sink failure. We'll support both modes and default to async with optional sync for high-fidelity tenants.
Performance tip: Use preallocated buffers and pooled proto messages to reduce GC overhead during high throughput.
Compatibility: Some legacy Jaeger clients expect legacy tag names; we'll include a lightweight attribute-mapper table per tenant to rewrite tags where necessary.
Security: No PII transformations in this ticket; if customers require redaction, create follow-up ENG ticket tied to private deployment KMS flows.
blockers: ENG-612345 - schema-guard feature required before enabling translation for some legacy tenants
Access to Tempo dev cluster credentials for integration tests (request submitted to infra)
rollout_plan: 1) Deploy multiplexer as opt-in feature flag in staging for 5 dev tenants. 2) Run 48h soak tests with traffic replay and golden-trace diffs. 3) Canary to 10% of traffic in production with throttling controls enabled. 4) Monitor dashboard metrics and escalate if gate_activation_count spikes. Rollback if write_fail rate > 2% or trace fidelity regressions detected.
implementation_notes: Will implement streaming path using existing OTLP ingest worker pool and add a lightweight multiplexer stage
Expose per-tenant policy config via Console API (read-only for this ticket, write via k8s configmap in Dedicated)
Add feature flag to flip between parallel and async mirror modes
Ensure idempotent writes for retries by including write sequence IDs for Tempo sink
